newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB seen selling 120,000 T wheat to Algeria-trade.
newsitem.headline: CWB seen selling 120,000 T wheat to Algeria-trade.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board sold at least 120,000 tonnes of milling wheat to Algeria in the past month, grain trade sources said.
CWB spokeswoman Rhea Yates declined comment.
Two grain sources said they heard the CWB sold milling wheat to Algeria.

Between 120,000 to 150,000 tonnes of No.2 Canada Western Red Spring wheat at 12.5 percent protein and No.3 CWRS were shipped to Algeria from Vancouver and Thunder Bay in the past month at US$147 to US$150 a tonne, cost, insurance and freight, one source said.
A total of 500,000 tonnes of Canadian milling wheat will be shipped to Algeria between May and September, the source said.
